description: This file defines the ReportTo entity class for the OrangeHRM project, modeling reporting relationships between employees including supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method, using Doctrine ORM annotations.

classes.name: ReportTo
classes.description: Entity class representing reporting relationships between employees, including supervisor, subordinate, and reporting method, with ORM mappings.

methods.name: getSupervisor
methods.description: Returns the supervisor employee associated with this report.

methods.name: setSupervisor
methods.description: Sets the supervisor employee for this report.

methods.name: getSubordinate
methods.description: Returns the subordinate employee associated with this report.

methods.name: setSubordinate
methods.description: Sets the subordinate employee for this report.

methods.name: getReportingMethod
methods.description: Returns the reporting method used in this relationship.

methods.name: setReportingMethod
methods.description: Sets the reporting method for this report.
